set.body: Read-only bounded product audit; no repository edits, candidate, provider-path access, or implementation authority. Inspect exactly /private/tmp/storyatlas-preview-qa.p32XrG/edition/preview.html and /private/tmp/storyatlas-preview-qa.p32XrG/visual-qa/preview-file-dpr2.png, record their SHA-256 identities, and judge the artifact itself rather than test counts. Deliver one public post that: (1) lists what a first-time reader can and cannot recover without result.json; (2) ties each failure to existing typed distinctions, especially source hierarchy/evidence, recall P/F/Viterbi, faithful-vs-distorted-vs-external, missing/imputed/unavailable/suppressed, and chronology/causality; (3) proposes the smallest self-contained static HTML/CSS redesign using same-document anchors/fragment focus and a complete textual twin, with no JavaScript/external resources and no colour-only meaning; (4) defines at most eight executable, fixture-based observable assertions for a later StoryAtlas implementation, explicitly separating those from any unrun human-usability study; (5) provides a compact text wireframe and priority order. Do not claim reader accuracy, preference, or accessibility performance without participants. Do not edit or inspect the frozen 11 output/provider recovery paths. Gate: exact artifact hashes, source-to-observation trace for every critique claim, internal consistency against docs/design/story-output-bundle-spec.md and candidate a7fa64 visualization court, and post/bead handoff. Ask chief before any code or sibling-repo mutation.
set.title: StoryAtlas preview perceptual audit and smallest static redesign
